description: Seals one plaintext bag of yours, one way, with a key derived from your citizen secret; afterwards only that secret opens it. Use it to protect a bag written on the legacy plaintext path. To delete a bag use locker_purge. Proof: your citizen secret as HTTP Authorization: Bearer, or in the leave_token argument. A controller-key signature alone cannot do this: the sealing key is derived from the secret. Writes go to grithgate.com; grithland.com is look-only and refuses them.

bag.description: Name of your bag to seal.

controller_public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 controller key, hex or base64url.

controller_signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the exact nonce bytes, by the bound controller key.

leave_token.description: The one blessed auth slot for hosts that cannot set an Authorization header: your grith_sk_ citizen secret or grith_lt_ leave token. Mapped to auth on arrival; never stored, logged, or echoed. NEVER another city's token — the fence refuses those by shape.

nonce.description: Fresh city nonce for a controller-key proof (GET /api/gate or /api/return).

name: locker_seal
title: Seal a locker bag
